subject: Multisession (list) capthist & mark-resight with fixed pID = error

messages.author: a24d06844d361733
messages.subject: Multisession (list) capthist & mark-resight with fixed pID = error
parts:
Hi folks, 

I have a series of capthist files, which I merge together as multiple sessions (all are independent sites, which I'm keen to share some parameters across and compare estimates): 

> glenelg_MRCH <- MS.capthist(MRCH_cobbob, MRCH_annya, MRCH_hotspur, MRCH_mt_clay)

This method works fine for capture-recapture, but fails when I use mark-resight with a fixed pID (this is sighting-only). It spits out the following error:
"Error in secr.fit(glenelg_MRCH, mask = glenelg_mask, trace = TRUE, detectfn = 1,  : 
  (list) object cannot be coerced to type 'double' "

It appears there is a bug in the secr.fit code at lines 192 & 193 with "markocc(traps(capthist)) == 0))". 
This section works when you specify a session, but not for all the sessions together:




 


Any thoughts on how to get around this? let me know if you want me to share some data.

Cheers,
Matt.
